name: Mirage/Anubis Sky Contrast & Gradient
purpose: Deepen washed-out desert skyboxes with rich cyan-azure gradient and cloud texture separation.
trigger_conditions: Outdoor site with visible skybox (Anubis canal, Mirage A-site, Dust2 long)
required_visual_conditions: Upper 30% of frame contains sky geometry.
required_masks_or_mattes: Linear gradient mask or sky luma qualifier.
recommended_color_palette: Deep Mediterranean azure (#0284c7) to warm horizon gold (#fef08a).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> ColorCorrector1 (Hue: 205, Sat: 1.25, Gamma: 0.85) masked by LinearGradientMask1 -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Color Page: Node with Qualifier keyed to Skybox, lower Lift/Gamma, shift tint towards #0284c7; apply soft feather.
qa_procedure: Check horizon boundaries around stone pillars and building rooftops for dark fringing or halo artifacts.
